purpose: Extends terminal-gate-checklist.json (C1-C8 process-only gates) with product completeness conditions P1-P3 that were absent from the June 5 sprint's exit criteria.
root_cause: terminal-gate-checklist.json evaluated 8 conditions (C1-C8) covering process fidelity (problem confirmed, evidence gathered, taskcards recorded, etc.) but had NO product completeness conditions. As a result, the sprint declared TERMINAL_GATE_PASSED with 2 CRITICAL open problems still unresolved.

product_conditions.label: Critical Problems Resolved or Governed
product_conditions.description: Every problem with severity=CRITICAL must be either CLOSED_VERIFIED or have an explicit unblocking taskcard with a defined execution lane and dependency chain.

PROB-001.blocker: PROB-009 (gap taxonomy) must be resolved first; then ZstdSharp NuGet integration

PROB-009.blocker: No upstream blocker — directly executable in Wave 2

product_conditions.current_result: FAIL — 2 CRITICAL open at HEAD; both GOVERNED with taskcards but not resolved
product_conditions.required_for_closure: PROB-001 and PROB-009 must reach CLOSED_VERIFIED or CLOSED_GOVERNED_PENDING_GATE

product_conditions.label: High Problems Resolved or Formally Deferred
product_conditions.description: Every problem with severity=HIGH must be either CLOSED_VERIFIED, CLOSED_GOVERNED_PENDING_GATE, or FORMALLY_DEFERRED with documented rationale and acceptance by project authority.
product_conditions.current_result: FAIL — 5 HIGH open; none formally deferred with written acceptance

product_conditions.label: Authority Consistency — poc-targets vs Source
product_conditions.description: All PASS claims in poc-targets.yaml must be consistent with current source code. No PROTOTYPE or stub implementation may be claimed PASS without explicit scope annotation.
product_conditions.current_result: FAIL — FodsOdsExporter PROTOTYPE vs PASS inconsistency unresolved

extended_gate_result.note: The original terminal-gate-checklist.json passing C1-C8 is a PROCESS PASS only. It does not constitute a product closure gate. This schema extension adds the missing product conditions.
